Option_C: she can be plotted on radar well enough to determine her heading
Option_D: her fog signal can be heard
Correct_Answer: she can be observed visually from the other vessel

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Which statement is TRUE   concerning two sailing vessels approaching each other?
Option_A: A sailing vessel overtaking another is the give-way vessel.
Option_B: When each is on a different tack, the vessel on the   starboard tack shall keep out of the way.
Option_C: A sailing vessel seeing another to leeward on an   undetermined tack shall hold her course.
Correct_Answer: A sailing vessel overtaking another is the give-way vessel.

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND What type of vessel or operation is indicated by a vessel showing two cones with the apexes together?
Option_A: Sailing vessel
Option_B: Vessel trawling
Option_C: Mineclearing
Correct_Answer: Vessel trawling

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A power-driven vessel has on her port side a sailing vessel which is on a collision course. The power-driven vessel is to ___________________.
Option_A: maintain course and speed
Option_B: keep clear, passing at a safe distance
Option_C: sound one blast and turn to starboard
Correct_Answer: keep clear, passing at a safe distance

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND At specified intervals, a vessel towing in fog shall sound _________________.
Option_A: one prolonged blast
Option_B: two prolonged blasts
Option_C: one prolonged and two short blasts in succession
Option_D: one prolonged and three short blasts in succession
Correct_Answer: one prolonged and two short blasts in succession

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A vessel towing in fog shall sound a fog signal of _________________.
Option_A: one prolonged blast every one minute
Option_B: two prolonged blasts every two minutes
Option_C: one prolonged and two short blasts every two minutes
Option_D: one prolonged blast every two minutes
Correct_Answer: one prolonged and two short blasts every two minutes

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Continuous sounding of a fog whistle by a vessel is a signal ___________________.
Option_A: that the vessel is anchored
Option_B: to request the draw span of a bridge to be opened
Option_C: of distress
Option_D: that the vessel is broken down and drifting
Correct_Answer: of distress

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL AND INLAND A 50-meter vessel is towing astern and the length of the tow is 100 meters. In addition to sidelights, which lights may she show to fully comply with the Rules?
Option_A: Two masthead lights forward, a sternlight, and a towing  light above the sternlight
Option_B: A masthead light forward, two masthead lights aft, a  sternlight, and a towing light above the sternlight
Option_C: No masthead light forward, two masthead lights aft, a  sternlight, and a towing light above the sternlight
Option_D: Three masthead lights forward, one masthead light aft, and two towing lights in a vertical line at the stern
Correct_Answer: A masthead light forward, two masthead lights aft, a  sternlight, and a towing light above the sternlight

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A vessel, which is unable to maneuver due to some exceptional circumstance, shall exhibit ___________________.
Option_A: during the day, three balls in a vertical line
Option_B: during the day, three shapes, the highest and lowest being balls and the middle being a diamond
Option_C: when making way at night, two all-round red lights,   sidelights, and a sternlight
Option_D: when making way at night, masthead lights, sidelights, and a sternlight
Correct_Answer: when making way at night, two all-round red lights,   sidelights, and a sternlight

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Which signal, other than a  distress signal, can be used by a vessel to attract   attention?
Option_A: Searchlight beam
Option_B: Continuous sounding of a fog signal apparatus
Option_C: Burning barrel
Correct_Answer: Searchlight beam

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Which statement is TRUE   concerning the light used with whistle signals?
Option_A: Use of such a light is required.
Option_B: The light shall have the same characteristics as a masthead light.
Option_C: It is only used to supplement short blasts of the whistle.
Correct_Answer: It is only used to supplement short blasts of the whistle.

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND What is the minimum sound  signaling equipment required aboard a vessel 14 meters in length?
Option_A: A bell only
Option_B: A whistle only
Option_C: A bell and a whistle
Option_D: Any means of making an efficient sound signal
Correct_Answer: A bell and a whistle

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND The towing light is a(n) ______.
Option_A: flashing amber light
Option_B: yellow light with the same characteristics as the sternlight
Option_C: all-round yellow light
Option_D: yellow light with the same characteristics as the masthead light
Correct_Answer: yellow light with the same characteristics as the sternlight

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND An all-round flashing yellow light may be exhibited by a(n) _________________.
Option_A: vessel not under command
Option_B: air cushion vessel in the nondisplacement mode
Option_C: vessel towing a submerged object
Correct_Answer: air cushion vessel in the nondisplacement mode

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND When should the fog signal of a manned vessel under tow be sounded?
Option_A: After the towing vessel's fog signal
Option_B: Before the towing vessel's fog signal
Option_C: Approximately one minute after the towing vessel's fog  signal
Option_D: If the towing vessel is sounding a fog signal, the   manned vessel being towed is not required to sound any fog signal.
Correct_Answer: After the towing vessel's fog signal

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A lantern combining a vessel's navigation lights may be shown on a ________________.
Option_A: 15-meter sailing vessel
Option_B: 20-meter vessel engaged in fishing and making way
Option_C: 25-meter power-driven vessel trolling
Correct_Answer: 15-meter sailing vessel

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A vessel engaged in fishing  during the day would show _______________.
Option_A: one black ball
Option_B: two cones with bases together
Option_C: a cone, apex downward
Correct_Answer: two cones, apexes together

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A sailing vessel is NOT required to keep out of the way of a _____________________.
Option_A: power-driven vessel
Option_B: vessel not under command
Option_C: vessel restricted in her ability to maneuver
Correct_Answer: power-driven vessel

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Which vessel may sound the  danger signal?
Option_A: The stand-on vessel in a crossing situation
Option_B: The give-way vessel in a crossing situation
Option_C: A vessel at anchor
Correct_Answer: All of the above

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND While underway in fog, you hear a vessel sound one prolonged blast followed by two short blasts on the whistle. What does this signal indicate?
Option_A: A vessel towing
Option_B: A vessel engaged in pilotage duty
Option_C: A vessel being towed
Correct_Answer: A vessel towing

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND If you saw flames aboard a  vessel but could see the vessel was not on fire, you would know that the _____.
Option_A: crew was trying to get warm
Option_B: vessel required immediate assistance
Option_C: vessel was attempting to attract the attention of a pilot boat
Option_D: vessel was being illuminated for identification by aircraft
Correct_Answer: vessel required immediate assistance

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND By day, when it is impracticable for a small vessel engaged in diving operations to display the shapes for a vessel engaged in underwater operations, she shall display ___________________.
Option_A: three black balls in a vertical line
Option_B: two red balls in a vertical line
Option_C: a black cylinder
Option_D: a rigid replica of the International Code flag "A"
Correct_Answer: a rigid replica of the International Code flag "A"

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A vessel will NOT show   sidelights when _________________.
Option_A: underway but not making way
Option_B: making way, not under command
Option_C: not under command, not making way
Correct_Answer: not under command, not making way

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Which display indicates a vessel conducting mineclearance operations?
Option_A: Three balls in a vertical line
Option_B: Two balls in a vertical line
Option_C: One ball near the foremast and one ball at each yardarm
Option_D: One diamond near the foremast and one ball at each yardarm
Correct_Answer: One ball near the foremast and one ball at each yardarm

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Which vessel MUST show two  masthead lights in a vertical line?
Option_A: A power-driven vessel less than 50 meters in length with a 20-meter tow
Option_B: A sailing vessel towing a small vessel astern
Option_C: A vessel not under command
Correct_Answer: A power-driven vessel less than 50 meters in length with a 20-meter tow

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND The duration of each blast of the whistle signals used in meeting and crossing situations is _________________.
Option_A: about 1 second
Option_B: 2 or 4 seconds
Option_C: 4 to 6 seconds
Correct_Answer: about 1 second

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND What dayshape should a vessel being towed exhibit if the tow EXCEEDS 200 meters?
Option_A: Two balls
Option_B: Two diamonds
Option_C: One ball
Correct_Answer: One diamond

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Which statement is TRUE when you are towing more than one barge astern at night?
Option_A: Only the last barge in the tow must be lighted.
Option_B: Only the first and last barges in the tow must be lighted.
Option_C: All barges in the tow must be lighted.
Option_D: All barges, except unmanned barges, must be lighted.
Correct_Answer: All barges in the tow must be lighted.

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A vessel is being propelled both by sail and by engines. Under the Rules, the vessel is  ________________.
Option_A: a "special circumstance" vessel
Option_B: not covered under any category
Option_C: a sail vessel
Correct_Answer: a power-driven vessel

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND The white masthead light  required for a power-driven vessel under the Rules is  visible over how many degrees of the horizon?
BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Which statement is TRUE   concerning lights and shapes for towing vessels?
Option_A: If a tow exceeds 200 meters in length, the towing vessel will display a black ball during daylight.
Option_B: When towing astern, a vessel will carry her identification lights at the masthead in addition to her regular masthead light.
Option_C: When towing astern, the towing vessel may show either a  sternlight or a towing light, but not both.
Option_D: If the towing vessel is over 50 meters in length, she must carry forward and after masthead lights.
Correct_Answer: If the towing vessel is over 50 meters in length, she must carry forward and after masthead lights.

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A vessel may use any sound or light signals to attract the attention of another vessel as long as ___________________.
Option_A: white lights are not used
Option_B: red and green lights are not used
Option_C: the vessel signals such intentions over the radiotelephone
Option_D: the signal cannot be mistaken for a signal authorized by the Rules
Correct_Answer: the signal cannot be mistaken for a signal authorized by the Rules

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND What type of vessel or operation is indicated by a vessel displaying two cones with the  apexes together?
Option_A: Sailing
Option_B: Trawling
Option_C: Minesweeping
Correct_Answer: Trawling

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND The rule regarding look-outs applies _____________________.
Option_A: in restricted visibility
Option_B: between dusk and dawn
Option_C: in heavy traffic
Correct_Answer: All of the above

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND While underway and towing, your vessel enters fog. Which fog signal should you sound?
Option_A: One prolonged blast
Option_B: Two prolonged blasts
Option_C: One prolonged blast and two short blasts
Correct_Answer: One prolonged blast and two short blasts

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A vessel engaged in fishing must display a light in the direction of any gear that extends outward more than 150 meters. The color of this light is _________________.
Option_A: white
Option_B: green
Option_C: red
Correct_Answer: white

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Which statement is true   concerning a towing light when a towing vessel is towing astern?
Option_A: When a towing light is shown, no sternlight is necessary.
Option_B: When a sternlight is shown, no towing light is necessary.
Option_C: The towing light is shown below the sternlight.
Option_D: The towing light is shown above the sternlight.
Correct_Answer: The towing light is shown above the sternlight.

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND At night, a vessel which is less than 7 meters in length and anchored in an area where other vessels do not normally navigate is ___________________.
Option_A: not required to show any anchor lights
Option_B: required to show a flare-up light
Option_C: required to show one white light
Option_D: required to show sidelights and a sternlight
Correct_Answer: not required to show any anchor lights

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND You are in charge of a 120-meter power-driven vessel at anchor in fog, sounding the required anchor signals. You hear the fog signal of a vessel  underway off your port bow. You may sound _______________.
Option_A: at least five short and rapid blasts
Option_B: two short blasts
Option_C: one short, one prolonged, and one short blast
Correct_Answer: one short, one prolonged, and one short blast

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND When taking action to avoid  collision, you should ___________________.
Option_A: make sure the action is taken in enough time
Option_B: not make any large course changes
Option_C: not make any large speed changes
Correct_Answer: make sure the action is taken in enough time

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Which vessel would have no white lights visible when meeting her head-on?
Option_A: A vessel trawling
Option_B: A vessel restricted in her ability to maneuver
Option_C: A vessel mineclearing
Correct_Answer: A vessel not under command

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND You are in restricted visibility and hear a fog signal forward of the beam. Nothing appears on your radar screen. You must ___________.
Option_A: stop your engines
Option_B: sound two prolonged blasts of the whistle
Option_C: sound the danger signal
Correct_Answer: slow to bare steerageway

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A towing vessel 30 meters in length is pushing barges ahead. How many white masthead lights is the vessel REQUIRED to show at night?
Option_A: One
Option_B: Two
Option_C: Three
Correct_Answer: Two

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND While underway in fog you hear a vessel sound one prolonged blast followed by two short  blasts. What does this signal indicate?
Option_A: A vessel towing
Option_B: A vessel being towed
Option_C: A pilot vessel engaged on pilotage duty
Correct_Answer: A vessel towing

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A power-driven vessel with a 150-meter stern tow shall display _____.
Option_A: three masthead lights in a vertical line
Option_B: a towing light above the sternlight
Option_C: two towing lights in a vertical line
Option_D: a red light over a white light at the masthead
Correct_Answer: a towing light above the sternlight

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A vessel transferring cargo  while underway is classified by the Rules as a vessel  _________________.
Option_A: not under command
Option_B: in special circumstances
Option_C: restricted in her ability to maneuver
Correct_Answer: restricted in her ability to maneuver

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Which vessel, when anchored at night, is NOT required to show anchor lights?
Option_A: A power-driven vessel
Option_B: A vessel engaged on pilotage duty
Option_C: A vessel dredging
Option_D: A vessel restricted in her ability to maneuver
Correct_Answer: A vessel dredging

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A vessel towing is showing three forward white masthead lights in a vertical line. This  means that the length of the ________________.
Option_A: towing vessel is less than 50 meters
Option_B: towing vessel is greater than 50 meters
Option_C: tow is less than 200 meters
Correct_Answer: tow is greater than 200 meters

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Which vessel is "underway" under the Rules of the Road?
Option_A: A vessel at anchor with the engine running
Option_B: A vessel with a line led to a tree onshore
Option_C: A vessel drifting with the engine off
Correct_Answer: A vessel drifting with the engine off

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Which vessel may exhibit  identifying lights when not actually engaged in her   occupation?
Option_A: A trawler
Option_B: A fishing vessel
Option_C: A tug
Correct_Answer: None of the above

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A 25-meter vessel trawling will show the dayshape(s) consisting of _______________.
Option_A: a basket
Option_B: two balls
Option_C: two cones, apexes together
Correct_Answer: two cones, apexes together

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A power-driven vessel underway shall keep out of the way of a _________________.
Option_A: vessel not under command
Option_B: vessel engaged in fishing
Option_C: sailing vessel
Correct_Answer: All of the above

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A fog signal of one short, one prolonged, and one short blast may be sounded by a ________.
Option_A: vessel at anchor
Option_B: vessel not under command
Option_C: vessel towing
Correct_Answer: vessel at anchor

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A continuous sounding of a  fog-signal apparatus indicates _____.
Option_A: the vessel is in distress
Option_B: the vessel has completed loading dangerous cargo
Option_C: it is safe to pass
Correct_Answer: the vessel is in distress

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND You are underway in restricted§visibility. You hear the fog signal of another vessel about§22° on your starboard bow. If danger of collision exists§you must __________.
Option_A: reduce your speed to bare steerageway
Option_B: slow your engines and let the other vessel pass ahead of you
Option_C: alter the course to starboard to pass around the other vessel's stern
Option_D: alter course to port to pass the other vessle on its port side
Correct_Answer: reduce your speed to bare steerageway

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND While underway in fog you hear a whistle signal consisting of one prolonged blast followed immediately by two short blasts. This signal is sounded in fog by _________________.
Option_A: vessels at anchor, not engaged in fishing
Option_B: vessels underway and towing
Option_C: vessels in danger
Correct_Answer: vessels underway and towing

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Which statement is TRUE of a 30-meter sailing vessel underway?
Option_A: She must show sidelights and a sternlight in restricted  visibility.
Option_B: She may show an all-round white light at the top of the  mast.
Option_C: She need not show a sternlight if she is showing all-round lights on the mast.
Option_D: If she is using propelling machinery, she shall show forward a shape consisting of two cones, apexes together.
Correct_Answer: She must show sidelights and a sternlight in restricted  visibility.

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A power-driven vessel towing another vessel astern (tow less than 200 meters) shall show _______________.
Option_A: three masthead lights in a vertical line instead of   either the forward or after masthead light
Option_B: two masthead lights in a vertical line instead of either the forward or after masthead lights
Option_C: two towing lights in a vertical line at the stern
Option_D: a small white light aft of the funnel
Correct_Answer: two masthead lights in a vertical line instead of either the forward or after masthead lights

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A vessel which is "restricted in her ability to maneuver" under the Rules, is a vessel which is _____________________.
Option_A: mineclearing
Option_B: engaged in fishing
Option_C: at anchor
Correct_Answer: mineclearing

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND When a vessel signals her  distress by means of a gun or other explosive signal, the firing should be at intervals of approximately _____.
Option_A: 10 minutes
Option_B: 1 minute
Option_C: 1 hour
Correct_Answer: 1 minute

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A "head on" situation shall be§deemed to exist at night when a power-driven vessel sees another power-driven vessel ahead and _________________.
Option_A: one sidelight and the masthead light are visible
Option_B: the vessels will pass closer than half a mile
Option_C: both vessels sound one prolonged blast
Option_D: both sidelights and masthead light(s) are visible
Correct_Answer: both sidelights and masthead light(s) are visible

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A 20-meter vessel is towing  another vessel astern. The length of the tow from the stern of the towing vessel to the stern of the tow is 75 meters. How many white towing masthead lights shall the towing  vessel show at night?
BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A vessel enagaged in fishing,§and at anchor, shall show _____________.
Option_A: an anchor light
Option_B: sidelights and a sternlight
Option_C: three lights in a vertical line, the highest and lowest  being red, and the middle being white
Correct_Answer: None of the above

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A power-driven vessel underway shall keep out of the way of a vessel _______________.
Option_A: not under command
Option_B: restricted in her ability to maneuver
Option_C: engaged in fishing
Correct_Answer: All of the above

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A vessel sounding a fog signal of one short, one prolonged, and one short blast is   indicating that the vessel is _______________.
Option_A: fishing
Option_B: in distress
Option_C: at anchor
Correct_Answer: at anchor

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Two all-round red lights§displayed in a vertical line are shown by a vessel ________.
Option_A: being towed
Option_B: pushing a barge ahead
Option_C: at anchor
Correct_Answer: not under command

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Your vessel is underway in§reduced visibility. You hear the fog signal of another§vessel about 30‚ on your starboard bow. If danger of§collision exists, you must _______.
Option_A: alter course to starboard to pass around the other vessel's stern
Option_B: slow your engines and let the other vessel pass ahead of you
Option_C: reduce your speed to bare steerageway
Option_D: alter course to port and pass the other vessel on its port side
Correct_Answer: reduce your speed to bare steerageway

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND You are underway in fog and you hear one prolonged blast followed by two short blasts. This is a vessel _________________.
Option_A: towing
Option_B: engaged on pilotage duty
Option_C: aground in a fairway
Option_D: stopped and making no way through the water
Correct_Answer: towing

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A sailing vessel is NOT allowed to show the all-round red over green lights on the mast if __________________.
Option_A: she is showing sidelights
Option_B: her sidelights are combined and shown on the fore and aft centerline of the vessel
Option_C: she is showing a sternlight
Option_D: her sidelights and sternlight are combined in one lantern and shown on the mast
Correct_Answer: her sidelights and sternlight are combined in one lantern and shown on the mast

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A power-driven vessel, when  towing astern, shall show _____.
Option_A: two towing lights in a vertical line
Option_B: a towing light in a vertical line above the sternlight
Option_C: two towing lights in addition to the sternlight
Option_D: a small white light in lieu of the sternlight
Correct_Answer: a towing light in a vertical line above the sternlight

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND According to the Rules, which vessel is NOT "restricted in her ability to maneuver"?
Option_A: A vessel servicing a navigation marker
Option_B: A sailing vessel
Option_C: A vessel mineclearing
Correct_Answer: A sailing vessel

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Distress signals may be _____.
Option_A: red flares
Option_B: smoke signals
Option_C: sound signals
Correct_Answer: Any of the above

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND When anchoring a 25-meter vessel at night, you must show __________________.
Option_A: one all-round white light
Option_B: two all-round white lights
Option_C: one all-round white light and the sidelights
Correct_Answer: one all-round white light

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND You are approaching another  vessel at night. You can see both red and green sidelights and, above the level of the sidelights, three white lights in a vertical line. The vessel may be _________________.
Option_A: not under command
Option_B: towing a tow more than 200 meters astern
Option_C: trawling
Correct_Answer: towing a tow more than 200 meters astern

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A vessel engaged in fishing, and at anchor, should exhibit _____.
Option_A: an anchor light
Option_B: sidelights and sternlight
Option_C: three lights in a vertical line, the highest and lowest  being red, and the middle being white
Correct_Answer: None of the above

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND In a crossing situation on open waters, a sailing vessel shall keep out of the way of all the following vessels EXCEPT a ___________________.
Option_A: vessel not under command
Option_B: vessel restricted in her ability to maneuver
Option_C: power-driven vessel approaching on her starboard side
Correct_Answer: power-driven vessel approaching on her starboard side

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND You are at anchor in fog on a§120-meter power-driven vessel. You hear the fog signal of§a vessel approaching off your port bow. You may sound ____.
Option_A: one prolonged, one short and one prolonged
Option_B: two short blasts
Option_C: one short, one prolonged, and one short blast
Correct_Answer: one short, one prolonged, and one short blast

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A power-driven vessel making way through the water sounds a fog signal of ________________.
Option_A: one prolonged blast at intervals of not more than two  minutes
Option_B: two prolonged blasts at intervals of not more than two  minutes
Option_C: one prolonged blast at intervals of not more than one  minute
Option_D: two prolonged blasts at intervals of not more than one  minute
Correct_Answer: one prolonged blast at intervals of not more than two  minutes

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND You are on watch in the fog. Your vessel is proceeding at a safe speed when you hear a fog signal ahead of you. The Rules require you to navigate with caution and, if danger of collision exists, _________.
Option_A: slow to less than 2 knots
Option_B: stop your engines
Option_C: reduce to bare steerageway
Correct_Answer: reduce to bare steerageway

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND In restricted visibility, a  vessel fishing with nets shall sound at intervals of two minutes ________________.
Option_A: one prolonged blast
Option_B: one prolonged followed by two short blasts
Option_C: one prolonged followed by three short blasts
Correct_Answer: one prolonged followed by two short blasts

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A 20-meter sailing vessel  underway must exhibit a _______________.
Option_A: sternlight
Option_B: combined lantern
Option_C: red light over a green light at the masthead
Correct_Answer: sternlight

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND At night, you are towing a  partly submerged vessel, 20 meters in length and 4 meters in breadth. What lights must you display on the towed vessel?
Option_A: A white light at the stern
Option_B: Two white lights side by side at the stern
Option_C: A white light at the forward end and a white light at the after end
Option_D: Two red lights in a vertical line at the after end
Correct_Answer: A white light at the forward end and a white light at the after end

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND All of the following vessels are "restricted in their ability to maneuver" EXCEPT a vessel ___________________.
Option_A: laying a pipeline
Option_B: dredging
Option_C: mineclearing
Correct_Answer: not under command

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND What lights must be shown on a barge being towed astern at night?
Option_A: A white light at each corner
Option_B: A white light fore and aft
Option_C: Sidelights and a sternlight
Correct_Answer: Sidelights and a sternlight

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A vessel which is unable to  maneuver due to some exceptional circumstance, shall show two red lights in a vertical line and ___________________.
Option_A: during the day, three balls in a vertical line
Option_B: during the day, three shapes, the highest and lowest being balls and the middle being a diamond
Option_C: when making way at night, sidelights and a sternlight
Option_D: when making way at night, masthead lights, sidelights, and a sternlight
Correct_Answer: when making way at night, sidelights and a sternlight

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND You are underway and approaching a bend in the channel where vessels approaching from the opposite direction cannot be seen. You should sound ______.
Option_A: one blast, 4 to 6 seconds in duration
Option_B: three blasts, 4 to 6 seconds in duration
Option_C: one continuous blast until you are able to see around the bend
Option_D: one blast, 8 to 10 seconds in duration
Correct_Answer: one blast, 4 to 6 seconds in duration

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A vessel which is fishing must show sidelights and a sternlight only when _______________.
Option_A: anchored
Option_B: underway
Option_C: dead in the water
Correct_Answer: underway and making way

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A power-driven vessel towing astern shall show _____.
Option_A: two towing lights in a vertical line
Option_B: a towing light in a vertical line above the sternlight
Option_C: two towing lights in addition to the sternlight
Option_D: a small white light in lieu of the sternlight
Correct_Answer: a towing light in a vertical line above the sternlight

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND You are underway in fog when you hear the following signal: one short blast, one prolonged blast and one short blast in succession. Which of the  following would it be?
Option_A: A sailing vessel underway with the wind abaft the beam
Option_B: A power-driven vessel underway and making way through the water
Option_C: A vessel at anchor
Correct_Answer: A vessel at anchor

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND If you hear the firing of a gun at one minute intervals from another vessel, this indicates that ___________________.
Option_A: the gun is being used to sound passing signals
Option_B: the vessel is in distress
Option_C: all vessels are to clear the area
Option_D: all is clear and it is safe to pass
Correct_Answer: the vessel is in distress

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Fog signals, required under the Rules for vessels underway, shall be sounded ______________.
Option_A: only on the approach of another vessel
Option_B: only when vessels are in sight of each other
Option_C: at intervals of not more than one minute
Option_D: at intervals of not more than two minutes
Correct_Answer: at intervals of not more than two minutes

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A towing vessel is towing two barges astern. The length of the tow from the stern of the tug to the stern of the last barge is 250 meters. The  towing vessel is 45 meters in length. How many white  masthead lights should be displayed on the tugboat at night?
BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND At night, a vessel shall  indicate that she is restricted in her ability to maneuver by showing in a vertical line two ___________________.
Option_A: red lights
Option_B: red lights and two white lights
Option_C: red lights with a white light in between
Option_D: white lights with a red light in between
Correct_Answer: red lights with a white light in between

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Your power-driven vessel is  underway when you sight a sailing vessel on your port bow. Which vessel is the "stand-on" vessel?
Option_A: The sailboat, because it is to port of your vessel
Option_B: The sailboat, because it is under sail
Option_C: Your vessel, because it is a power-driven vessel
Option_D: Your vessel, because it is to starboard of the sailboat
Correct_Answer: The sailboat, because it is under sail

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Five or more short blasts on a vessel's whistle indicates that she is _______________.
Option_A: in doubt that another vessel is taking sufficient action to avoid a collision
Option_B: altering course to starboard
Option_C: altering course to port
Option_D: the stand-on vessel and will maintain course and speed
Correct_Answer: in doubt that another vessel is taking sufficient action to avoid a collision

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Which statement concerning  maneuvering in restricted visibility is FALSE?
Option_A: A vessel which cannot avoid a close-quarters situation with a vessel forward of her beam shall reduce her speed to bare steerageway.
Option_B: A vessel which hears a fog signal forward of her beam shall stop her engines.
Option_C: A vessel which hears a fog signal forward of the beam shall navigate with caution.
Option_D: If a vessel determines by radar that a close-quarters  situation is developing, she shall take avoiding action in ample time.
Correct_Answer: A vessel which hears a fog signal forward of her beam shall stop her engines.

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A vessel being towed astern  shall show at night _________________.
Option_A: the lights required for a power-driven vessel underway
Option_B: only the required masthead lights
Option_C: a sternlight only
Correct_Answer: sidelights and a sternlight

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND In order for a stand-on vessel to take action in a situation, she must determine that the other vessel _____.
Option_A: is restricted in her ability to maneuver
Option_B: has sounded the danger signal
Option_C: is not taking appropriate action
Option_D: has not changed course since risk of collision was   determined
Correct_Answer: is not taking appropriate action

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND While underway your vessel  approaches a bend in a river where, due to the bank, you cannot see around the bend. You should _________________.
Option_A: keep to the starboard side of the channel and sound one  short blast
Option_B: sound the danger signal
Option_C: sound one prolonged blast
Option_D: slow your vessel to bare steerageway
Correct_Answer: sound one prolonged blast

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Which statement concerning  whistle signals is FALSE?
Option_A: When a pushing vessel and a vessel pushed are connected in a composite unit, the unit sounds the fog signal of a   power-driven vessel.
Option_B: A vessel at anchor may sound one short, one prolonged, and one short blast.
Option_C: A pilot vessel may sound an identity signal on the whistle.
Option_D: A vessel engaged in towing in fog shall sound a fog signal at intervals of one minute.
Correct_Answer: A vessel engaged in towing in fog shall sound a fog signal at intervals of one minute.

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A sailing vessel of over  20 meters in length underway must show a _____.
Option_A: red light over a green light at the masthead
Option_B: white masthead light
Option_C: combined lantern
Correct_Answer: sternlight

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND An inconspicuous, partly  submerged vessel or object being towed, where the length of tow is 100 meters, shall show _______________.
Option_A: yellow lights at each end
Option_B: two red lights in a vertical line
Option_C: a black ball
Correct_Answer: a diamond shape

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND You are approaching a narrow channel. You see a vessel that can only be navigated safely within the channel. You should ___________.
Option_A: initiate an exchange of passing signals
Option_B: not cross the channel if you might impede the other vessel
Option_C: sound the danger signal
Correct_Answer: not cross the channel if you might impede the other vessel

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A man aboard a vessel, signaling by raising and lowering his outstretched arms to each side, is indicating ___________________.
Option_A: danger, stay away
Option_B: all is clear, it is safe to pass
Option_C: the vessel is anchored
Correct_Answer: a distress signal

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Your 15-meter vessel is crossing a narrow channel and a large cargo vessel to port is within the channel and crossing your course. You must _________.
Option_A: hold course and speed
Option_B: sound the danger signal
Option_C: initiate an exchange of passing signals
Option_D: do not cross the channel if you might impede the other  vessel
Correct_Answer: do not cross the channel if you might impede the other  vessel

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A vessel towed astern shall show _____________________.
Option_A: masthead lights
Option_B: sidelights
Option_C: a special flashing light
Correct_Answer: sidelights

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A power-driven vessel making way through the water sounds which fog signal?
Option_A: Two short blasts every one minute
Option_B: One short blast every one minute
Option_C: Two prolonged blasts every two minutes
Option_D: One prolonged blast every two minutes
Correct_Answer: One prolonged blast every two minutes

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND You are towing two barges  astern. The length of the tow from the stern of the tug to the stern of the last barge is 150 meters. How many white towing identification lights should be displayed on the  tugboat at night?
BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Which vessel may show three  lights in a vertical line, the top and bottom being red and the middle being white?
Option_A: A vessel engaged in diving operations
Option_B: A pilot vessel
Option_C: A vessel trawling
Correct_Answer: A vessel engaged in diving operations

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A power-driven vessel has on her port side a sailing vessel which is on a collision course. The power-driven vessel is required to ____________.
Option_A: maintain course and speed
Option_B: keep clear
Option_C: sound one blast and turn to starboard
Correct_Answer: keep clear

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A single towing light will be carried above a vessel's sternlight _____.
Option_A: only if she is towing astern
Option_B: only if the tow exceeds 200 meters
Option_C: at any time when towing
Option_D: if the towing vessel is part of a composite unit
Correct_Answer: only if she is towing astern

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Which dayshape must be shown by a vessel 25 meters in length aground during daylight hours?
Option_A: One black ball
Option_B: Two black balls
Option_C: Three black balls
Correct_Answer: Three black balls

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND An orange flag showing a black circle and square is a _______________.
Option_A: signal indicating a course change
Option_B: distress signal
Option_C: signal of asking to communicate with another vessel
Correct_Answer: distress signal

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND When is a stand-on vessel FIRST allowed by the Rules to take action in order to avoid  collision?
Option_A: When the two vessels are less than half a mile from each other.
Option_B: When the give-way vessel is not taking appropriate action to avoid collision.
Option_C: When collision is imminent.
Option_D: The stand-on vessel is never allowed to take action.
Correct_Answer: When the give-way vessel is not taking appropriate action to avoid collision.

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND You are crossing a narrow  channel in a 15-meter vessel when you sight a tankship off your port bow coming up the channel. Which statement is TRUE?
Option_A: Yours is the give-way vessel because it is less than 30  meters long.
Option_B: You shall not impede the safe passage of the tankship.
Option_C: The tankship is the stand-on vessel because it is to port of your vessel.
Option_D: The tankship is the stand-on vessel because it is the larger of the two vessels.
Correct_Answer: You shall not impede the safe passage of the tankship.

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND In restricted visibility, a  vessel restricted in her ability to maneuver, at anchor, would sound a fog signal of ___________________.
Option_A: the rapid ringing of a bell for five seconds every minute
Option_B: two prolonged and two short blasts every two minutes
Option_C: one prolonged and two short blasts every two minutes
Option_D: two prolonged and one short blast every two minutes
Correct_Answer: one prolonged and two short blasts every two minutes

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A 15-meter sailing vessel would be required to show _________________.
Option_A: sidelights, sternlight, and a red light over a green light on the mast
Option_B: sidelights, and sternlight, but they may be in a combined lantern on the mast
Option_C: separate sidelights and sternlight
Correct_Answer: sidelights, and sternlight, but they may be in a combined lantern on the mast

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND The use of the signal consisting of five or more short blasts on the ship's whistle _______________.
Option_A: replaces directional signals
Option_B: makes the other vessel the give-way vessel
Option_C: indicates doubt as to the other vessel's action
Option_D: makes it necessary to slow or stop
Correct_Answer: indicates doubt as to the other vessel's action

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND While underway in fog, you hear the fog signal of another vessel ahead. If a risk of  collision exists, you must _____________.
Option_A: slow to bare steerageway and navigate with caution
Option_B: sound three short blasts and back your engines
Option_C: stop your engines and navigate with caution
Option_D: continue on your course and speed until the other vessel is sighted
Correct_Answer: slow to bare steerageway and navigate with caution

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND What lights, if any, would you exhibit at night if your vessel were broken down and being towed by another vessel?
Option_B: Same lights as for a power-driven vessel underway
Option_C: A white light forward and a white light aft
Option_D: The colored sidelights and a white sternlight
Correct_Answer: The colored sidelights and a white sternlight

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND If your vessel is underway in fog and you hear one prolonged and three short blasts, this indicates a _____________________.
Option_A: vessel not under command
Option_B: sailing vessel
Option_C: vessel in distress
Correct_Answer: vessel being towed

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND At night, which lights would you see on a vessel engaged in fishing, other than trawling?
Option_A: Two red lights, one over the other
Option_B: A green light over a red light
Option_C: A red light over a white light
Option_D: A white light over a red light
Correct_Answer: A red light over a white light

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND You are on a vessel nearing a bend in the channel where, because of the height of the  bank, you cannot see a vessel approaching from the opposite direction. You should sound _________________.
Option_A: one short blast
Option_B: one prolonged blast
Option_C: one long blast
Correct_Answer: one prolonged blast

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Systems of inbound and outbound lanes to promote the safe flow of vessel traffic in certain areas around the world are known as _______________.
Option_A: merchant vessel reporting systems
Option_B: traffic separation schemes
Option_C: collision avoidance fairways
Correct_Answer: traffic separation schemes

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A tug is towing three manned barges in line in fog. The first vessel of the tow should sound ________________.
Option_A: no fog signal
Option_B: one short blast
Option_C: one prolonged and three short blasts
Option_D: one prolonged, one short, and one prolonged blast
Correct_Answer: no fog signal

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND All fog signals shall be sounded every two minutes with the exception of a vessel _________.
Option_A: underway or making way
Option_B: under sail or under tow
Option_C: anchored or aground
Option_D: not under command or restricted in her ability to maneuver
Correct_Answer: anchored or aground

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND In reduced visibility, you hear two prolonged blasts of a whistle. This signal is sounded by a __________________.
Option_A: power-driven vessel dead in the water
Option_B: sailing vessel on the port tack
Option_C: vessel not under command
Correct_Answer: power-driven vessel dead in the water

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A 200-meter vessel restricted in her ability to maneuver, at anchor, will sound a fog signal of ___________________.
Option_A: a 5 second ringing of a bell forward and a 5 second sounding of a gong aft at intervals of 1 minute
Option_B: one prolonged followed by two short blasts every 2 minutes
Option_C: one prolonged followed by three short blasts every minute
Option_D: one prolonged followed by three short blasts every 2  minutes
Correct_Answer: one prolonged followed by two short blasts every 2 minutes

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND What dayshape is to be shown by a vessel aground?
Option_A: A cylinder
Option_B: Two cones with their apexes together
Option_C: Two black balls in a vertical line
Option_D: Three black balls in a vertical line
Correct_Answer: Three black balls in a vertical line

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND What is NOT a distress signal?
Option_A: Red flares or red rockets
Option_B: Continuous sounding of fog signalling apparatus
Option_C: International Code Flags "November" and "Charlie"
Correct_Answer: Basket hanging in the rigging

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Which statement is TRUE   concerning a vessel equipped with operational radar?
Option_A: She must use this equipment to obtain early warning of risk of collision.
Option_B: The use of a radar excuses a vessel from the need of a  look-out.
Option_C: The radar equipment is only required to be used in   restricted visibility.
Option_D: The safe speed of such a vessel will likely be greater than that of vessels without radar.
Correct_Answer: She must use this equipment to obtain early warning of risk of collision.

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A pilot vessel on pilotage duty shall show identity lights _____________.
Option_A: at any time while underway
Option_B: while at anchor
Option_C: while alongside a vessel
Correct_Answer: All of the above

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND You are underway in restricted visibility and hear a fog signal forward of the beam.  Nothing appears on your radar screen. You must _________.
Option_A: stop your engines
Option_B: sound two prolonged blasts of the whistle
Option_C: sound the danger signal
Correct_Answer: slow to bare steerageway

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A stand-on vessel in a§crossing situation is allowed to take action when _____.
Option_A: on a collision course
Option_B: the vessels will pass within one mile
Option_C: it becomes apparent to her that the give-way vessel is not taking appropriate action
Option_D: the relative speed of the vessels indicates collision in less than six minutes
Correct_Answer: it becomes apparent to her that the give-way vessel is not taking appropriate action

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Traffic separation schemes  established by the International Maritime Organization  __________________.
Option_A: provide inbound and outbound lanes to promote the safe flow of vessel traffic
Option_B: provide vessel reporting systems to assist in search and rescue in the event of a vessel casualty
Option_C: provide routing and vessel scheduling procedures to reduce shipping delays
Option_D: prohibit vessels carrying hazardous cargos from entering waters that are environmentally sensitive
Correct_Answer: provide inbound and outbound lanes to promote the safe flow of vessel traffic

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Which vessel is required to  sound a fog signal of one prolonged followed by two short blasts?
Option_A: A vessel not under command
Option_B: A sailing vessel, underway
Option_C: A vessel restricted in its ability to maneuver, at anchor
Correct_Answer: All of the above

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND At night, a broken down vessel being towed would show the same lights as _________________.
Option_A: a power-driven vessel underway
Option_B: the towing vessel
Option_C: a barge
Correct_Answer: a barge

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND What is the optional whistle signal which may be sounded by a vessel at anchor?
Option_A: Two prolonged followed by one short blast
Option_B: One short followed by two prolonged blasts
Option_C: One short, one prolonged, followed by one short blast
Correct_Answer: One short, one prolonged, followed by one short blast

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND The minimum length of a   power-driven vessel that must show forward and after  masthead lights is _________________.
Option_A: 30 meters
Option_B: 50 meters
Option_C: 75 meters
Correct_Answer: 50 meters

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND What light(s), if any, would you show at night if your vessel was broken down and being towed astern by another vessel?
Option_B: Same lights as for a power-driven vessel underway
Option_C: A white light forward and a white light aft
Option_D: The colored sidelights and a white sternlight
Correct_Answer: The colored sidelights and a white sternlight

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A vessel not under command  making way at night would show _________________.
Option_A: two all-round red lights in a vertical line
Option_B: anchor lights and sidelights
Option_C: two all-round white lights in a vertical line, sidelights and a sternlight
Option_D: two all-round red lights in a vertical line, sidelights, and a sternlight
Correct_Answer: two all-round red lights in a vertical line, sidelights, and a sternlight

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND In a dense fog, you hear a  whistle signal of one prolonged blast followed by three  short blasts. This signal is sounded by a ____________.
Option_A: manned vessel being towed
Option_B: fishing vessel underway trawling
Option_C: pilot vessel underway making a special signal
Correct_Answer: manned vessel being towed

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND While underway and pushing a barge ahead, your vessel enters a heavy rain storm. You should sound _________________.
Option_A: a prolonged blast every two minutes
Option_B: two prolonged blasts every two minutes
Option_C: one prolonged and two short blasts every two minutes
Option_D: one prolonged and three short blasts every two minutes
Correct_Answer: one prolonged and two short blasts every two minutes

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND On open waters, a power-driven vessel shall keep out of the way of a ___________________.
Option_A: vessel on her port side that is crossing her course
Option_B: vessel that is overtaking her
Option_C: seaplane on the water
Correct_Answer: sailing vessel

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND You are overtaking a vessel at night and you see a yellow light showing above the   sternlight of the overtaken vessel. The overtaken vessel is _________________.
Option_A: underway and dredging
Option_B: pushing ahead or towing alongside
Option_C: towing astern
Correct_Answer: towing astern

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Your vessel is at anchor in§fog. The fog signal of another vessel, apparently underway,§has been growing louder and the danger of collision appears§to exist. In addition to your fog signal, what signal may§be used to indicate your presence?
Option_A: No signal other than your fog signal may be used.
Option_B: One prolonged, one short, and one prolonged whistle blast
Option_C: One prolonged followed by two short whistle blasts
Option_D: One short, one prolonged, and one short whistle blast
Correct_Answer: One short, one prolonged, and one short whistle blast

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND All of the following are  distress signals under the Rules EXCEPT ___________________.
Option_A: International Code Signal "AA"
Option_B: orange-colored smoke
Option_C: red flares
Option_D: the repeated raising and lowering of outstretched arms
Correct_Answer: International Code Signal "AA"

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A tug is towing three manned barges in line in fog. The third vessel of the tow should sound _________________.
Option_A: no fog signal
Option_B: one prolonged and two short blasts
Option_C: one prolonged and three short blasts
Option_D: one prolonged, one short and one prolonged blast
Correct_Answer: one prolonged and three short blasts

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A power-driven vessel,§when towing another vessel astern shall show the light(s)§in Diagram ___________.
BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Which vessel is NOT classified as "restricted in her ability to maneuver"?
Option_A: A vessel picking up a navigation mark
Option_B: A vessel transferring cargo while underway
Option_C: A vessel whose anchor is fouled
Option_D: A vessel in a towing operation that restricts the ability of the vessel and her tow to change their course
Correct_Answer: A vessel whose anchor is fouled

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND During the day, a vessel picking up a submarine cable shall carry _________________________.
Option_A: three shapes, the highest and lowest shall be red balls, and the middle shall be a white diamond
Option_B: two black balls
Option_C: three shapes; the highest and lowest shall be black balls, and the middle shall be a red diamond
Option_D: three shapes; the highest and lowest shall be black balls and the middle shall be a black diamond
Correct_Answer: three shapes; the highest and lowest shall be black balls and the middle shall be a black diamond

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND While underway in fog, you hear a prolonged blast from another vessel. This signal   indicates a _______________.
Option_A: sailboat underway
Option_B: power-driven vessel underway, towing
Option_C: power-driven vessel underway
Correct_Answer: power-driven vessel underway

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND While underway your vessel  enters fog. You stop your engines and the vessel is dead in the water. Which fog signal should you sound?
Option_A: One prolonged blast every two minutes
Option_B: Two prolonged blasts every two minutes
Option_C: Three short blasts every two minutes
Option_D: One prolonged and three short blasts every two minutes
Correct_Answer: Two prolonged blasts every two minutes

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND You are underway in a fog when you hear a whistle signal of one prolonged blast followed by two short blasts. This signal could indicate all of the following EXCEPT a vessel _________________________.
Option_A: being towed
Option_B: not under command
Option_C: fishing with trawls
Correct_Answer: being towed

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A light signal consisting of three flashes means _________________.
Option_A: "I am in doubt as to your actions"
Option_B: "My engines are full speed astern"
Option_C: "I desire to overtake you"
Correct_Answer: "I am operating astern propulsion"

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND You are watching another vessel§approach and her compass bearing is not changing. This §means that _____.
Option_A: you are the stand-on vessel
Option_B: a risk of collision exists
Option_C: a special circumstances situation exists
Option_D: the other vessel is dead in the water
Correct_Answer: a risk of collision exists

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A vessel 30 meters in length and aground would display a dayshape consisting of ____________.
Option_A: a cylinder
Option_B: one black ball
Option_C: two black balls in a vertical line
Option_D: three black balls in a vertical line
Correct_Answer: three black balls in a vertical line

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND What is NOT a distress signal?
Option_A: A continuous sounding of the fog horn
Option_B: Firing a gun every minute
Option_C: Five or more short rapid blasts on the whistle
Option_D: A square flag and ball flown from the mast
Correct_Answer: Five or more short rapid blasts on the whistle

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Which statement is true   concerning a vessel equipped with operational radar?
Option_A: The Master of the vessel must be on the bridge when the  radar is in use.
Option_B: The radar equipment is only required to be used in   restricted visibility.
Option_C: The use of a radar excuses a vessel from the need of a  look-out.
Option_D: This equipment must be used to obtain early warning of risk of collision.
Correct_Answer: This equipment must be used to obtain early warning of risk of collision.

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND While underway in fog you hear another vessel sounding two prolonged blasts every two  minutes. This signal indicates a vessel _________________.
Option_A: making way through the water
Option_B: towing
Option_C: drifting
Correct_Answer: drifting

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Fog signals for vessels§at anchor or aground shall be sounded at intervals of not§more than _____.
Option_A: 15 minutes
Option_B: 5 minutes
Option_C: 2 minutes
Correct_Answer: 1 minutes

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A vessel is carrying three  lights in a vertical line. The highest and lowest of these are red and the middle light is white. Which statement is always TRUE?
Option_A: During the day, she would display three balls in a vertical line.
Option_B: If making way, she would show masthead lights at night.
Option_C: If at anchor, she need not show anchor lights while   displaying identifying lights.
Option_D: Her fog signal would consist of a rapid ringing of a bell for five seconds every minute.
Correct_Answer: If making way, she would show masthead lights at night.

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND You are on a power-driven vessel§in fog. Your vessel is proceeding at a safe speed when you§hear a fog signal ahead of you. The Rules require you to§navigate with caution and, if danger of collision exists§_________.
Option_A: slow to less than 2 knots
Option_B: reduce to bare steerageway
Option_C: stop your engines
Correct_Answer: reduce to bare steerageway

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND While underway in a fog you hear a signal of three strokes of a bell, a rapid ringing of the bell, and three more strokes of the bell. This signal is made by a vessel _______________.
Option_A: at anchor and giving warning
Option_B: aground
Option_C: at anchor and greater than 100 meters in length
Option_D: not under command and at anchor
Correct_Answer: aground

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND The maximum length of a  power-driven vessel which may show an all-round white light and sidelights instead of a masthead light, sidelights and a sternlight is ___________________.
Option_A: 7 meters
Option_B: 10 meters
Option_C: 11 meters
Correct_Answer: 11 meters

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND While underway in fog, you hear a signal of one prolonged blast followed by three short  blasts. This is the fog signal for a vessel ______________.
Option_A: towing
Option_B: being towed (manned)
Option_C: under sail
Correct_Answer: being towed (manned)

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Which vessel is to sound a fog signal of one prolonged followed by two short blasts?
Option_A: A vessel not under command
Option_B: A sailing vessel underway
Option_C: A vessel restricted in its ability to maneuver, at anchor
Correct_Answer: All of the above

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND At night you observe a vessel ahead show three flashes of a white light. This signal  indicates that the vessel ahead is _______________.
Option_A: in distress
Option_B: approaching a bend in the channel
Option_C: operating astern propulsion
Correct_Answer: operating astern propulsion

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND The use of the danger signal ___________________.
Option_A: replaces directional signals
Option_B: makes the other vessel the stand-on vessel
Option_C: indicates doubt as to another vessels actions
Option_D: is the same as a "MAYDAY" signal
Correct_Answer: indicates doubt as to another vessels actions

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Which power-driven vessel is NOT required to carry a light in the position of the after  masthead light?
Option_A: A pushing vessel and a vessel being pushed, in a composite unit and 100 meters in length
Option_B: A vessel of 60 meters in length towing astern
Option_C: A vessel of 45 meters in length trolling
Option_D: Any vessel constrained by her draft
Correct_Answer: A vessel of 45 meters in length trolling

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Which requirement must be met in order for a stand-on vessel to take action to avoid   collision?
Option_A: Risk of collision must exist.
Option_B: The give-way vessel must have taken action first.
Option_C: The vessels must be within half a mile of each other.
Option_D: There are no requirements to be met. The stand-on vessel may take action anytime.
Correct_Answer: Risk of collision must exist.

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A single vessel being towed alongside shall exhibit __________________.
Option_A: one all-round white light
Option_B: sidelights and a sternlight
Option_C: only the outboard sidelight and a sternlight
Option_D: a masthead light, sidelights, and a sternlight
Correct_Answer: sidelights and a sternlight

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND You are crossing a narrow  channel on your 15-meter vessel. A deeply loaded cargo  vessel is proceeding down the channel as shown in DIAGRAM 40. In this situation, which statement is correct?
Option_A: You are the stand-on vessel because you are less than 65 feet in length.
Option_B: You cannot impede the passage of the cargo vessel.
Option_C: The cargo vessel is the stand-on vessel because she is running with the current.
Option_D: The Rule of Special Circumstances applies in this case.
Correct_Answer: You cannot impede the passage of the cargo vessel.

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND In which situation would risk of collision definitely exist?
Option_A: A vessel is 22 degrees on your port bow, range increasing, bearing changing slightly to the right.
Option_B: A vessel is broad on your starboard beam, range decreasing, bearing changing rapidly to the right.
Option_C: A vessel is 22 degrees abaft your port beam, range   increasing, bearing is constant.
Option_D: A vessel is on your starboard quarter, range decreasing, bearing is constant.
Correct_Answer: A vessel is on your starboard quarter, range decreasing, bearing is constant.

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A vessel nearing a bend or an area of a channel or fairway where other vessels may be  obscured by an intervening obstruction shall sound _______.
Option_A: one long blast
Option_B: one prolonged blast
Option_C: the danger signal
Correct_Answer: one prolonged blast

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND In fog, you hear apparently  forward of your beam a fog signal of 2 prolonged blasts in succession every two minutes. This signal indicates a  _________________.
Option_A: power-driven vessel making way through the water
Option_B: vessel being pushed ahead
Option_C: vessel restricted in her ability to maneuver
Option_D: power-driven vessel underway but stopped and making no way through the water
Correct_Answer: power-driven vessel underway but stopped and making no way through the water

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A vessel being towed will show __________________.
Option_A: a forward masthead light
Option_B: sidelights and a sternlight
Option_C: a towing light
Correct_Answer: sidelights and a sternlight

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND In fog, a vessel being towed, if manned, shall sound a fog signal of _______________________.
Option_A: two short blasts
Option_B: three short blasts
Option_C: one prolonged and two short blasts
Option_D: one prolonged and three short blasts
Correct_Answer: one prolonged and three short blasts

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Which vessel is directed not to impede the passage of a vessel which can only navigate  inside a narrow channel?
Option_A: A vessel of less than 20 meters in length
Option_B: A vessel not under command
Option_C: A vessel engaged in surveying
Correct_Answer: A vessel of less than 20 meters in length

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND What dayshape must be shown on a partly submerged vessel which is being towed?
Option_A: A diamond
Option_B: A cone
Option_C: One black ball
Option_D: Two black balls in a vertical line
Correct_Answer: A diamond

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Which vessel is to be regarded as a vessel "restricted in her ability to maneuver"?
Option_A: A vessel fishing with trawls
Option_B: A vessel which has lost the use of her steering gear
Option_C: A vessel with a draft of such depth that she cannot change her course
Correct_Answer: A vessel engaged in mineclearing

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Which vessel would show 3  dayshapes in a vertical line, the highest and lowest being balls and the middle shape being a diamond?
Option_A: Vessel not under command
Option_B: Vessel constrained by her draft
Option_C: Vessel minesweeping
Option_D: Vessel restricted in her ability to maneuver
Correct_Answer: Vessel restricted in her ability to maneuver

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A power-driven vessel "not under command" at night must show which lights in a vertical line?
Option_A: Three red
Option_B: Two red
Option_C: Two white
Correct_Answer: Two red

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND In order for a vessel to be  "engaged in fishing" she must be _____________________.
Option_A: underway
Option_B: using gear which extends more than 50 meters outboard
Option_C: using a seine of some type
Option_D: using gear which restricts her maneuverability
Correct_Answer: using gear which restricts her maneuverability

Question_Text: INTERNATIONAL ONLY While underway and in sight of§another vessel you put your engines on astern propulsion.§Which statement concerning whistle signals is TRUE?
Option_A: You must sound three short blasts on the whistle.
Option_B: You must sound one blast if backing to starboard.
Option_C: You must sound whistle signals only if the vessels are meeting.
Option_D: You need not sound any whistle signals.
Correct_Answer: You must sound three short blasts on the whistle.

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND When shall the stand-on vessel in a crossing situation take action to avoid the other  vessel?
Option_A: When a risk of collision exists
Option_B: When action by the give-way vessel alone will not prevent a collision
Option_C: When the bearing to give-way vessel becomes steady
Option_D: When the vessels become less than 1/2 mile apart
Correct_Answer: When action by the give-way vessel alone will not prevent a collision

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND What signal would a vessel  aground show during daylight?
Option_A: One black ball
Option_B: Two black balls
Option_C: Three black balls
Correct_Answer: Three black balls

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Which is NOT a distress signal?
Option_A: Flames on a vessel
Option_B: Vertical motion of a white lantern at night
Option_C: Code flags "November" and "Charlie"
Correct_Answer: Vertical motion of a white lantern at night

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Which statement about a 25-meter auxiliary sailboat is TRUE?
Option_A: The sidelights and sternlight may be combined in one  lantern.
Option_B: When operating under sail, her fog signal would consist of one prolonged blast.
Option_C: She may show a green light over a red light at the masthead.
Correct_Answer: She must show fixed sidelights.

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Which vessel shall NOT impede the passage of a vessel which can safely navigate only  within a narrow channel or fairway?
Option_A: A vessel of less than 20 meters in length
Option_B: A vessel sailing
Option_C: A vessel fishing
Correct_Answer: All of the above

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND While underway in a fog, you hear a whistle signal of one prolonged blast followed by two short blasts. This signal could mean all of the following EXCEPT a vessel _____.
Option_A: not under command
Option_B: towing astern
Option_C: fishing with trawls
Correct_Answer: being towed

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND In which situation do you  think a risk of collision exists?
Option_A: A vessel is 22‚ on your port bow, range increasing, bearing changing slightly to the right.
Option_B: A vessel is broad on your starboard beam, range decreasing, bearing changing rapidly to the right.
Option_C: A vessel is 22‚ abaft your port beam, range increasing,  bearing is constant.
Option_D: A vessel is on your starboard quarter, range decreasing, bearing is constant.
Correct_Answer: A vessel is on your starboard quarter, range decreasing, bearing is constant.

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A vessel aground in fog shall sound, in addition to the proper anchor signal, which of the following?
Option_A: Three strokes on the gong before and after sounding the  anchor signal
Option_B: Three strokes on the bell before and after the anchor signal
Option_C: Four short blasts on the whistle
Option_D: One prolonged and one short blast on the whistle
Correct_Answer: Three strokes on the bell before and after the anchor signal

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Two vessels are approaching each other near head on. What action should be taken to avoid collision?
Option_A: The first vessel to sight the other should give way.
Option_B: The vessel making the slower speed should give way.
Option_C: Both vessels should alter course to starboard.
Option_D: Both vessels should alter course to port.
Correct_Answer: Both vessels should alter course to starboard.

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Your vessel is 25 meters long and anchored in restricted visibility. You are required to sound the proper fog signal at intervals of not more than _____________.
Option_A: 30 seconds
Option_B: one minute
Option_C: two minutes
Correct_Answer: one minute

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND While underway in fog, you hear a short blast, a prolonged blast, and a short blast of a whistle. This signal indicates a _____________________.
Option_A: vessel towing in fog
Option_B: sailboat underway in fog
Option_C: vessel being towed in fog
Correct_Answer: vessel anchored in fog

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND You are the stand-on vessel in a crossing situation. You may hold your course and speed  until _____.
Option_A: the other vessel takes necessary action
Option_B: the other vessel gets to within half a mile of your vessel
Option_C: action by the give-way vessel alone will not prevent  collision
Option_D: the other vessel gets to within a quarter mile of your  vessel
Correct_Answer: action by the give-way vessel alone will not prevent  collision

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND The arc of visibility for  sidelights is from right ahead to _____.
Option_A: 22.5° abaft the beam
Option_B: abeam
Option_C: 22.5° forward of the beam
Correct_Answer: 22.5° abaft the beam

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND In narrow channels, vessels of less than what length shall not impede the safe passage of vessels which can navigate only inside that channel?
Option_A: 20 meters
Option_B: 50 meters
Option_C: 65 meters
Correct_Answer: 20 meters

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND At night a vessel displaying the lights illustrated in DIAGRAM 82 is ________________.
Option_A: sailing
Option_B: fishing
Option_C: a pilot boat
Correct_Answer: fishing

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND While underway and in sight of another vessel crossing less than .5 mile away, you put your engines full speed astern. Which statement concerning whistle signals is TRUE?
Option_A: You must sound three short blasts on the whistle.
Option_B: You must sound one blast if backing to starboard.
Option_C: You must sound whistle signals only if the vessels are  meeting.
Option_D: You need not sound any whistle signals.
Correct_Answer: You must sound three short blasts on the whistle.

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A vessel showing a yellow light over a white light at night is a vessel ______.
Option_A: engaged in piloting
Option_B: towing astern
Option_C: engaged in fishing
Correct_Answer: towing astern

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A vessel hearing a fog§signal forward of her beam has not determined if risk§of collision exists. She shall reduce speed to _____.
Option_A: moderate speed
Option_B: safe speed
Option_C: half speed
Correct_Answer: bare steerageway

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Two vessels are in an overtaking§situation. Which of the lights on the overtaken vessel will§the overtaking vessel see?
Option_A: Two masthead lights
Option_B: One masthead light and a sidelight
Option_C: Both sidelights
Correct_Answer: Sternlight only

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND While underway and making way your vessel enters fog. Which fog signal should you sound every two minutes?
Option_A: One prolonged blast
Option_B: Two prolonged blasts
Option_C: Three short blasts
Option_D: A prolonged blast and three short blasts
Correct_Answer: One prolonged blast

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND On open water, a vessel fishing is in a crossing situation with a vessel sailing located on the fishing vessel's starboard side. Which vessel is the stand-on vessel?
Option_A: The fishing vessel because it is to port of the sailing  vessel.
Option_B: The fishing vessel because it is fishing.
Option_C: The sailing vessel because it is to starboard of the fishing vessel.
Option_D: The sailing vessel because it is sailing.
Correct_Answer: The fishing vessel because it is fishing.

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND The lights prescribed by the Rules shall be exhibited _____.
Option_A: from sunrise to sunset in restricted visibility
Option_B: at all times
Option_C: from sunset to sunrise, and at no other time
Correct_Answer: from sunrise to sunset in restricted visibility

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Risk of collision may exist  _____.
Option_A: if the compass bearing of an approaching vessel does NOT appreciably change
Option_B: even when an appreciable bearing change is evident,   particularly when approaching a vessel at close range
Option_C: if you observe both sidelights of a vessel ahead for an  extended period of time
Correct_Answer: All of the above

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND "Safe speed" is defined as that speed where _____.
Option_A: you can stop within your visibility range
Option_B: you can take proper and effective action to avoid collision
Option_C: you are traveling slower than surrounding vessels
Option_D: no wake comes from your vessel
Correct_Answer: you can take proper and effective action to avoid collision

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A vessel showing a green light over a white light in a vertical line above the level of the sidelights is _____________.
Option_A: engaged in underwater construction
Option_B: under sail and power
Option_C: a pilot vessel
Correct_Answer: trawling

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND A vessel being towed at night must show ______________.
Option_A: a white all-round light
Option_B: sidelights and a sternlight
Option_C: a flashing yellow light
Correct_Answer: sidelights and a sternlight

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND To determine if risk§of collision exists, a vessel which is fitted with radar§must use _____.
Option_A: radar scanning
Option_B: radar plotting
Option_C: compass bearings
Correct_Answer: All of the above

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND If a vessel is engaged in  fishing according to the definitions in the Rules, it will have ______________.
Option_A: gear extending from the side or stern
Option_B: gear that restricts maneuverability
Option_C: less than 50 percent trolling lines
Correct_Answer: gear that restricts maneuverability

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND While underway in fog you hear the rapid ringing of a bell. What does this signal   indicate?
Option_A: A vessel backing down
Option_B: A sailboat underway
Option_C: A vessel at anchor
Correct_Answer: A vessel at anchor

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Two power-driven vessels are crossing so as to involve risk of collision. Which statement is TRUE, according to the Rules?
Option_A: The vessel which has the other on her own port side shall keep out of the way.
Option_B: If the stand-on vessel takes action, she shall avoid  changing course to port.
Option_C: If the give-way vessel takes action, she shall avoid  changing course to starboard.
Option_D: The give-way vessel should keep the other vessel to her  starboard.
Correct_Answer: If the stand-on vessel takes action, she shall avoid  changing course to port.

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND What is the minimum vessel  length which must show two white masthead lights, one  forward and one aft, when underway at night?
Option_A: 7 meters
Option_B: 20 meters
Option_C: 50 meters
Correct_Answer: 50 meters

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND Every vessel that is to keep out of the way of another vessel must take positive early action to comply with this obligation and must _____.
Option_A: avoid crossing ahead of the other vessel
Option_B: avoid passing astern of the other vessel
Option_C: sound one prolonged blast to indicate compliance
Option_D: alter course to port for a vessel on her port side
Correct_Answer: avoid crossing ahead of the other vessel

Question_Text: BOTH INTERNATIONAL & INLAND At night, a power-driven vessel less than 12 meters in length may, instead of the normal navigation lights, show sidelights and one ___________________.
Option_A: white light
Option_B: yellow light
Option_C: flashing white light
Correct_Answer: white light
